prompt.text:
Implement a self-contained TypeScript reducer for an account menu.

Export `AccountMenuState`, `AccountMenuAction`, and `updateAccountMenu(state, action): AccountMenuState`.

`AccountMenuState` contains:
- `open: boolean`
- `signedIn: boolean`
- `email: string`
- `displayName: string`
- `destination: string | null`

Actions are `toggle`, `showProfile`, and `signOut`.

Rules:
- `toggle` flips `open` only when signed in. When signed out it returns the exact same object.
- `showProfile` only works when signed in and open; it closes the menu and sets destination to `/account`. Otherwise return the exact same object.
- `signOut` only works when signed in. It closes the menu, sets `signedIn` false, clears email and display name, and sets destination to `/signed-out`. Otherwise return the exact same object.
- Successful transitions return new objects and never mutate the input.
- Empty email or display-name strings are permitted because this reducer does not validate profile data.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
